title: Menkpack
description: Menkoe pack is a pack for a server with a player called menkoe turned into a golem and more
body:
# 🧡 Da Menkoe pack

Adds a custom **copper golem** styled after the player **Menkoe**.

---

## ✨ Features

* 🧡 Custom golem based on Menkoe
* 🎮 Simple and lightweight

---

## 📦 Description

This pack introduces a unique copper golem inspired by the player **Menkoe**, bringing a fun and personalized touch to your world or server.

Perfect for use on the **Synergy Server** or any world where you want a custom golem companion.

---

## ⚙️ Requirements

* Minecraft **1.21.11**
* Fabric (if required by your setup)

---

## 🚀 Installation

1. Download the pack
2. Place it in your mods/resourcepacks folder (depending on type)
3. Launch the game and enjoy

---

## ❤️ Credits

* Skin inspiration: **Menkoe**

---

A small addition, but full of personality 🧡
THIS IS APPROVED BY MENKOE
